scope: Developer-only housing guidance candidates; not installed in production starter corpus or player. Original short summaries, no copied forum bodies/media.
review_method: Canonical rendered text plus anonymous HTTPS HTML; original comment IDs, author developer class/profile and Steam epoch checked separately from quoted copies. HTML/body checksums retained; raw pages stay private. No future source refresh implied.
limits: Historical developer statements, not current-patch mechanics, source API contracts, exact geometry, optimal blueprint examples or execution authorization.
Topic EA64 is contextual evidence, not a verified exact game build; both records intentionally retain unknown version compatibility.
Community comments about caves, timing or capacity are not attributed to the developer. The 2022 future-fix statement does not prove delivery in any later release.
Published timestamps derive from Steam epoch attributes; visible localized timezone labels are not independently attested.
Production promotion still requires source integration, baseline-preserving migration, retrieval and exact-source provider/core/distribution/player gates.
